query:
WITH claimed AS (
    INSERT INTO user_blob_charge(user_id, content_hash)
    SELECT $1, content_hash
    FROM UNNEST($2::TEXT[]) AS value(content_hash)
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, content_hash) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING content_hash
),
account AS (
    UPDATE user_storage_account
    SET used_bytes=used_bytes+$3
    WHERE user_id=$1
    RETURNING user_id
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claimed)::BIGINT AS claimed_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account)::BIGINT AS account_count;
